title: Uniqueness and isomorphism in the pointwise truncation limit argument
statement: The hypotheses and data of lem-pc-ringed-space-pointwise-truncation-limit imply that every compatible morphism c : E ⟶ K is an isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem pointwise_truncation_limit_isIso (X : RingedSpace.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))] (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))) (hlocal : ∀ x : X, ∃ (b : ℤ → ℤ) (B : Set (Opens X)), (∀ U ∈ B, x ∈ U) ∧ (∀ V : Opens X, x ∈ V → ∃ U ∈ B, U ≤ V) ∧ (∀ (m : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (U : Opens X), U ∈ B → b m < (p : ℤ) → IsZero ((openModuleCohomology X p U).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (m - (p : ℤ))).obj E)))) [HasProduct (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E)] (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))) (π : K ⟶ ∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E)) (δ : (∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E)) ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (hK : IsDerivedLimitTriangle (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.natTransTruncGEOfLE (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(n : ℤ)) (by omega)).app E) K π δ) : (∀ c : E ⟶ K, (∀ n : ℕ, c ≫ π ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ => (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E) n = (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app E) → IsIso c)
